title: Revision journal source
description: Woodcore-Datei/journal.json, schema 1.0 -- the report's revision journal as Woodcore saves it, the source calc/journal.py exports from (docs/domain/journal.md §3.3terdecies). Written by Woodcore's «Journal» tab only. ONE file for the whole project, not one per entry: a journal is a single ordered list read as a whole, and nothing addresses one entry by an id -- so there is no folder, no `group` and no id to keep in step with a file name. An entry is written BY HAND, one per revision (the engineer's decision): nothing here is appended by an editor tab saving a drawing, which would put twenty entries in an afternoon's work. Every rule the walker below cannot express -- an index that is a whole number and not taken, a date that is a real day -- is checked by journal.check_source and by validation.validate_journal_business.

schema_version.description: -- pinned: a file written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

entries.description: The revisions, in the order they were written -- the export is what sorts them, newest first (journal.entries). An empty list is a project whose report has not been revised yet, and exports as an empty journal.

index.description: The revision's number, as a drawing's revision block numbers one: 1, 2, 3 ... Unique in the file. Woodcore proposes the largest plus one (journal.next_index), so a **gap is never refilled**: Rev. 2 deleted out of 1, 2, 3 leaves 2 unused and the next revision is 4. It is what the report prints as «Rev. 3» and what orders the journal.

date.description: The day of the revision, ISO: "2026-09-27". Typed by the engineer, and deliberately not taken from the clock -- a revision is dated by when it was decided, not by when it was entered -- which is also why the journal is ordered by its index and not by this field.

name.description: Who made the revision, in full, as the report prints it. Required: a revision nobody signs is not a revision. Woodcore prefills it from the entry before it.

initials.description: The short form of the office or of the person, as a revision block carries it: «FLL». Typed at every entry rather than read from a setting (the engineer's decision) -- a journal may carry entries by several offices -- and prefilled from the entry before it.

label.description: What the revision is, in a few words -- the one text every level of the report prints. Required: it is the whole of level 1. The engineer's own words, never translated (docs/typst/language.md §4bis).

summary.description: The short description, printed from level 2. Optional and may be empty: an entry whose label says it all («Erstausgabe») has none, and level 2 then prints the label alone rather than an empty cell.

description.description: The long description, printed at level 3 beside the two above -- level 3 shows everything an entry carries (the engineer's decision). Optional and may be empty.
